subject: Procurement & budget owners — next steps (Acme Corp)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — procurement questions & next steps

Hi Jordan & Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap + the few procurement items we need to map so we can move to contracting: 

1) Commercial path: Do you prefer to purchase via Purchase Order (PO), credit card, or via a cloud marketplace listing (AWS/GCP marketplace)? If PO, is there a preferred SOW + MSA flow?
2) Procurement timeline: target date for PO or final sign-off? Any upcoming procurement windows we should be aware of?
3) Budget owner / economic buyer: who signs off on the budget line for this type of infrastructure spend?
4) Finance sponsor & signatory: who will issue the PO and who is the legal signatory (finance, legal, or named signer)?
5) Required docs: we typically provide W-9, SOC 2 Type II report, standard DPA, and insurance certs. Any additional forms or vendor questionnaires?

Next steps I propose: I’ll send a short commercial summary + preliminary quote (attached). If PO path, we’ll prepare an MSA + SOW for your legal team; if marketplace is preferred we can share listing details and estimated contract length that works in marketplace flows.

Can you confirm answers to 1–4 and share the procurement contact (email) and preferred file type for the intake form (PDF/Doc)?

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick 15 min follow-up with procurement if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (555) 555-0142

Attachment: redwood-quote-Acme-20260329.pdf (preliminary quote, 1 page)

From: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Marcus Lee <marcus.lee@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Mar 2026 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — procurement questions & next steps

Hi Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Answers below based on our procurement/finance call: 

1) Commercial path: Primary preference is PO. That said, finance has asked whether a marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) is possible as it speeds approvals and centralizes billing. If you can support marketplace SKUs, that would be preferred.
2) Procurement timeline: Expect 4–6 weeks for PO processing assuming we have the SOW + MSA ready; Marketplace could drop that to ~2 weeks.
3) Budget owner / economic buyer: Priya Shah — Dir. Data Platforms (priya.shah@acme.com). She owns the budget and will sign off on the spend.
4) Finance sponsor & signatory: Marcus Lee, Head of Procurement (marcus.lee@acme.com) will raise the PO; Legal handles final signature for agreements over $250k — below that Marcus can approve. 
5) Required docs: Please provide W-9, SOC 2 report, DPA, insurance certificate, and our standard vendor intake form (attached). Also provide an editable SOW template so Legal can review faster.

I'm attaching the procurement intake PDF from our side — it lists the fields Procurement will need. If you can return a draft SOW and MSA and indicate whether the marketplace SKU is available, we can prioritize.

Thanks,
Jordan
Product Partnerships, Acme Corp

Attachment: acme-procurement-intake-20260329.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Smith <jordan.smith@acme.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2026 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery — procurement questions & next steps

Great — thanks Jordan, that helps a lot. TL;DR: marketplace preferred if available; otherwise PO + MSA/SOW. 

Here’s the plan I’ll execute this week: 
- I’ll attach a clean SOW template and the MSA redline we typically use for enterprise customers for your legal team to review.
- Vivek will confirm whether we can offer an AWS Marketplace SKU for Acme and provide the marketplace listing ETA / SKU.
- I’ll get W-9, SOC 2 report, DPA, and insurance certs to you by end of day tomorrow.
- Please confirm Priya as the budget owner and Marcus as procurement sponsor/signatory limit — I’ll flag the signatory threshold in the SOW cover note for Legal.

Proposed milestone: aim to have an agreed commercial path (marketplace vs PO) and an initial SOW in your Legal queue by 6 Apr so Procurement can process by mid-April. If Marketplace is available, we’ll aim for the earlier timeline Jordan mentioned. 

If you’d like us to route initial paperwork via DocuSign, say the word and I’ll prepare the envelope.

Best,
Marissa

Attachment: redwood-quote-Acme-20260329.pdf (updated 1-pg quote)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Procurement & budget owners — internal next steps (Acme)

Marissa / Aditya —

Quick internal note after reviewing Acme's intake form and Jordan's answers: 

- Marketplace: we do have an AWS Marketplace listing in the pipeline; for enterprise SKUs we can onboard Acme within ~7–10 business days if we prioritize. Marketplace will likely shorten procurement time and reduce PO friction — recommend offering marketplace as the primary path.
- PO path: if they insist on an internal PO we should prepare the MSA + short SOW and a single-line quote. Identify Legal reviewer and signatory threshold (Marcus handles up to $250k).
- Docs checklist to attach in the SOW cover email: W-9, SOC 2 Type II (redacted as needed), DPA, insurance cert, and the completed vendor intake form. Also include our standard tax forms if procurement asks.
- Pricing note: if they use Marketplace, billing is via marketplace and contractually we still provide an underlying MSA; we can offer a 6–12 month committed capacity SKU to make the cost predictable.

Action items for us:
- Marissa: send SOW + MSA & attachments to Jordan/Priya; confirm whether they want DocuSign.
- Aditya: prepare a marketplace SKU estimate and ETA; if marketplace not acceptable, prep a PO-friendly quote (single line + account code).
- Vivek: I’ll review Legal comments once they come back and coordinate the signatory thresholds.

I’ll sync with Legal if we see redlines above the $250k threshold.

-Vivek
VP, Commercial Operations
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
